messages:
Anita Patel: FYI — GA release: 'airgap-lite' on-prem installer is live. Docs + checklist on the Console -> Private > Installers. Key points: one-time image pull via our signed mirror, no long-running outbound traffic required after install. Telemetry defaults to OFF. (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/onprem/airgap-lite)

Leo Kim: Awesome. Does this support KMS integration in completely offline mode?

Anita Patel: Short answer: yes for customer-managed KMS via offline key import. See docs section 'KMS offline key import' — steps and RSA envelope format included.

Sienna Torres: Rollout note for SRE/support: new audit-log schema v2 — we added fields for request.route_id and model_variant. Please update any existing parsers. Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-airgap-lite

Ramon Diaz: Security checklist updated for HIPAA/PCI mapping. We require customers to attest to controls 3.1/4.2 before enabling remote-support. Also added HSM recommendation for high-risk customers.

support-bot: deploy-bot: installer build 1955123400 -> promoted to stable at 1955123456 :rocket: (sha256: abc123...)

Leo Kim: Upgrade path: can customers upgrade from v2 onprem to airgap-lite? any migration pitfalls?

Anita Patel: Yes — we added an automated migration tool in the installer: --migrate-from=v2. Limitations: existing external plugin integrations may need manual reconfiguration. We've documented known edge cases.

Sienna Torres: Heads-up: for Dedicated customers using our telemetry forwarding, default is off but opt-in token flows are supported. If you need to enable remotely for debugging, contact platform@redwood.com and include the customer's consent record.

Ramon Diaz: One more: attestation logs are now exportable in gzipped JSONL. Use `redwood-export --audit v2 --since 2026-03-01` for exports.

Anita Patel: Thanks all. Please RT if you own any docs/alerts that need updates. I'll run a brief Q/A tomorrow 10:30 PT in #announcements if anyone wants to join.

Leo Kim: Will share a short checklist in eng-platform.

Sienna Torres: I'll add automated parser tests to CI.

Anita Patel: :thumbsup:
